title: Ocheeze Eziokwu
intro: Onye ọchịchị dị ike, nke a maara maka amamihe dị ukwuu na ocheeze ya dị ebube, na-enweta ozi dị omimi site n'ebe a na-amaghị ama. Nkwurịta okwu a na-atụghị anya ya na-ama nkwenkwe na ikike ha aka, na-etinye ha n'ọrụ njem ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị nke ga-anwale ọgụgụ isi ha ma mechaa mee ka ha nwee mmụọ miri emi. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta njirimara nke onye ọchịchị a na ihe ndị mere gbanwere alaeze ha dum?
clues: Mụ na ndị m fere anyanwụ, na-eso ụzọ ndị nna nna anyị hà.
Nnụnụ, bụ́ nnụnụ na-agba ịnyịnya, bụ onye ozi a na-atụghị anya ya nke wetara m akwụkwọ ozi sitere n'aka onye ndu dị ike.
Iji nwalee amamihe nke onye zitere ya, ezitere m onyinye bara uru, mana eweghachiri m ha, ebe onye zitere ya nwere akụnụba ka ukwuu site n'aka Allah.
Tupu mụ erute n'obí onye zitere ya, e bufere ocheeze m dị ebube n'ụzọ ọrụ ebube n'otu ntabi anya.
Mgbe m rutere, a jụrụ m ma ocheeze e bufere ọ̀ bụ nke m, m wee zaa, sị, 'Ọ dị ka à ga-asị na ọ bụ ya kpọmkwem.'
Abanye m n'otu nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ nwere ala m chere na ọ bụ ọdọ mmiri, n'oge ahụ dị egwu, m tinyere onwe m n'okpuru Onye Amụma Sulaiman nye Allah, Onyenwe ụwa.

trial.label: Ihe Omume Etiti
options: Ịnata akwụkwọ ozi sitere n'aka onye amụma Sulaiman
Ịrụ ụgbọ iji lanarị idei mmiri
A na-ebo ya ebubo na ọ naghị eme ihe n'eziokwu
trial.answer: Ịnata akwụkwọ ozi sitere n'aka onye amụma Sulaiman

Ịbụ onye azụ̀ dị egwu loro
Ịtụfu nnukwu akụnụba dị ka ntaramahụhụ

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
